# Setting Introduction
In the year 2550, a now-unknown Earth-based company's research into the dimensional phenomenon known as "bluespace" somehow resulted in both their own dissapearance and the dissapearance of a large portion of South America. All memory and records thereof had also vanished, leaving no evidence they existed in the first place beyond their conspicious absence. Following this incident, SolGov, the main governing body of sapient species in the Milky Way, required all governments and corporations operating in their territories to sign the Blue Space Treaty, stipulating that all research into exotic materials and phenomena must be made completely public.
In the year 2564, the Earth-based megacorporation Nanotrasen discovered the substance known as "phoron" on a research expedition in the Lavaland system, located in the Spinward Sector of the Milky Way. Phoron's unusual molecular structure gives it properties bordering on magical, and it has potent applications in energy production, materials science, pharmaceutics, and robotics, among other fields. As the Spinward Sector is located far beyond SolGov's direct sphere of influence, Nanotrasen began the study of phoron in secret, giving them a drastic advantage in almost all industries and firmly cementing themselves as the wealthiest and most powerful corporation operating in SolGov space. Although their failure to disclose phoron research to the public is a direct violation of the Blue Space Treaty, Nanotrasen's effective monopoly on the acquisition, refinement, and distribution of phoron gives them a powerful political bargaining chip that they've used to evade any significant legal consequences.
The current year is 2566. At present, Nanotrasen operates a large fleet of space stations in the Spinward Sector, remotely monitored from a classified location by their Central Command station. The stated mission of their "Project 14" stations is to closely monitor and research the bluespace activity common to the sector, as well as salvaging and studying the various wrecked ships and alien artifacts drifting around the region. However, the Spinward Sector is inhabited by many dangerous entities, and Nanotrasen's status as a corporate titan has made their research stations a lucrative target for thieves and corporate rivals.
You are an employee working on one of Nanotrasen's space stations, and today is yet another shift. What could possibly go wrong?
